shloka_text: रावणग्रहणं तत्तु वायुग्रहणसन्निभम् । ततः पुलस्त्यः शुश्राव कथितं दिवि दैवतैः ।। 7.33.1 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇagrahaṇaṃ tattu vāyugrahaṇasannibham | tataḥ pulastyaḥ śuśrāva kathitaṃ divi daivataiḥ || 7.33.1 ||
translation: रावणग्रहणम् Ravana's capture, तत्तु that indeed, वायुग्रहणसन्निभम् like catching wind, ततः then, पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, शुश्राव heard, कथितम् spoken, दिवि in heaven, दैवतैः by the gods.
explanation: The capture of Ravana was as futile as trying to grasp the wind, and Pulastya heard the gods speaking of this in heaven.
comments: The sage Pulastya, Ravana's grandfather, hearing of his capture, comes to Mahishmati, where Arjuna receives him with reverence and, at his request, frees Ravana with honours and a fire-witnessed friendship -- Agastya draws the moral that there are ever stronger than the strong and none should be scorned -- freed but shamed, Ravana resumes his arrogant slaughter of kings.

shloka_text: ततः पुत्रकृतस्नेहात्कम्प्यमानो महाधृतिः । माहिष्मतीपतिं द्रष्टुमाजगाम महानृषिः ।। 7.33.2 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ putrakṛtasnehātkampyamāno mahādhṛtiḥ | māhiṣmatīpatiṃ draṣṭumājagāma mahānṛṣiḥ || 7.33.2 ||
translation: ततः then, पुत्रकृतस्नेहात् due to affection for his son, कम्प्यमानः trembling, महाधृतिः the greatly resolute one, माहिष्मतीपतिम् the lord of Mahishmati, द्रष्टुम् to see, आजगाम came, महानृषिः the great sage.
explanation: Then, trembling with affection for his son, the greatly resolute great sage Pulastya came to see the lord of Mahishmati.

shloka_text: स वायुमार्गमास्थाय वायुतुल्यगतिर्द्विजः । पुरीं माहिष्मतीं प्राप्तो मनःसम्पातविक्रमः ।। 7.33.3 ।।
transliteration: sa vāyumārgamāsthāya vāyutulyagatirdvijaḥ | purīṃ māhiṣmatīṃ prāpto manaḥsampātavikramaḥ || 7.33.3 ||
translation: सः he, वायुमार्गम् the aerial path, आस्थाय having taken, वायुतुल्यगतिः with speed like wind, द्विजः the brahmin, पुरीम् the city, माहिष्मतीम् Mahishmati, प्राप्तः reached, मनःसम्पातविक्रमः with valor like the speed of thought.
explanation: Taking the aerial path, that brahmin, with speed like the wind and valor like the speed of thought, reached the city of Mahishmati.

shloka_text: सो ऽमरावतिसङ्काशां हृष्टपुष्टजनाकुलाम् । प्रविवेश पुरीं ब्रह्मा इन्द्रस्येवामरावतीम् ।। 7.33.4 ।।
transliteration: so 'marāvatisaṅkāśāṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākulām | praviveśa purīṃ brahmā indrasyevāmarāvatīm || 7.33.4 ||
translation: सः he, अमरावतिसङ्काशां resembling Amaravati, हृष्टपुष्टजनाकुलाम् filled with happy and well-nourished people, प्रविवेश entered, पुरीम् the city, ब्रह्मा Pulastya, इन्द्रस्येव like Indra's, अमरावतीम् Amaravati.
explanation: He, Pulastya, entered that city, which resembled Amaravati and was bustling with happy and well-nourished people, just as Brahma would enter Indra's Amaravati.

shloka_text: पादचारमिवादित्यं निष्पतन्तं सुदुर्दशम् । ततस्ते प्रत्यभिज्ञाय अर्जुनाय निवेदयन् ।। 7.33.5 ।।
transliteration: pādacāramivādityaṃ niṣpatantaṃ sudurdaśam | tataste pratyabhijñāya arjunāya nivedayan || 7.33.5 ||
translation: पादचारम् on foot, इव like, आदित्यम् the sun, निष्पतन्तम् appearing, सुदुर्दशम् very difficult to behold, ततः then, ते they, प्रत्यभिज्ञाय having recognized, अर्जुनाय to Arjuna, निवेदयन् reported.
explanation: Then, seeing him appear like the sun walking on foot, very difficult to behold, they recognized him and reported his arrival to Arjuna.

shloka_text: पुलस्त्य इति विज्ञाय वचनाद्धैहयाधिपः । शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय प्रत्युद्गच्छत्तपस्विनम् ।। 7.33.6 ।।
transliteration: pulastya iti vijñāya vacanāddhaihayādhipaḥ | śirasyañjalimādhāya pratyudgacchattapasvinam || 7.33.6 ||
translation: पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, इति thus, विज्ञाय having known, वचनात् from the words, हैहयाधिपः the lord of Haihayas, शिरसि on the head, अञ्जलिम् folded hands, आधाय having placed, प्रत्युद्गच्छत् went forward to meet, तपस्विनम् the ascetic.
explanation: The lord of Haihayas, understanding from the words that it was Pulastya, placed his folded hands on his head in reverence and went forward to meet the ascetic.

shloka_text: पुरोहितो ऽस्य गृह्यार्घ्यं मधुपर्कं तथैव च । पुरस्तात्प्रययौ राज्ञः शक्रस्येव बृहस्पतिः ।। 7.33.7 ।।
transliteration: purohito 'sya gṛhyārghyaṃ madhuparkaṃ tathaiva ca | purastātprayayau rājñaḥ śakrasyeva bṛhaspatiḥ || 7.33.7 ||
translation: पुरोहितः the priest, अस्य his, गृह्य having taken, अर्घ्यम् water for respectful reception, मधुपर्कम् madhuparka, तथैव च and similarly, पुरस्तात् in front of, प्रययौ went forth, राज्ञः of the king, शक्रस्य of Indra, इव like, बृहस्पतिः Brihaspati.
explanation: His priest, having taken the arghya and madhuparka, went forth in front of the king, just as Brihaspati goes before Indra.

shloka_text: ततस्तमृषिमायान्तमुद्यन्तमिव भास्करम् । अर्जुनो दृश्य सम्भ्रान्तो ववन्देन्द्र इवेश्वरम् ।। 7.33.8 ।।
transliteration: tatastamṛṣimāyāntamudyantamiva bhāskaram | arjuno dṛśya sambhrānto vavandendra iveśvaram || 7.33.8 ||
translation: ततः then, तम् that, ऋषिम् sage, आयान्तम् approaching, उद्यन्तम् rising, इव like, भास्करम् the sun, अर्जुनः Arjuna, दृश्य having seen, सम्भ्रान्तः bewildered (with awe), ववन्दे bowed down, इन्द्रः Indra, इव like, ईश्वरम् the lord.
explanation: Then, Arjuna, seeing that sage approaching like the rising sun, was filled with awe and bowed down, just as Indra bows before the supreme lord.

shloka_text: स तस्य मधुपर्कं गां पाद्यमर्घ्यं निवेद्य च । पुलस्त्यमाह राजेन्द्रो हर्षगद्गदया गिरा ।। 7.33.9 ।।
transliteration: sa tasya madhuparkaṃ gāṃ pādyamarghyaṃ nivedya ca | pulastyamāha rājendro harṣagadgadayā girā || 7.33.9 ||
translation: सः he, तस्य to him, मधुपर्कम् madhuparka, गाम् a cow, पाद्यम् water for washing feet, अर्घ्यम् water for respectful reception, निवेद्य having offered, च and, पुलस्त्यम् to Pulastya, आह said, राजेन्द्रः the king of kings, हर्षगद्गदया with a voice choked with joy, गिरा with words.
explanation: Having offered madhuparka, a cow, water for washing feet, and arghya to Pulastya, the king of kings then spoke to him with a voice choked with joy.

shloka_text: अद्यैवममरावत्या तुल्या माहिष्मती कृता । अद्याहं तु द्विजेन्द्र त्वां यस्मात्पश्यामि दुर्दशम् ।। 7.33.10 ।।
transliteration: adyaivamamarāvatyā tulyā māhiṣmatī kṛtā | adyāhaṃ tu dvijendra tvāṃ yasmātpaśyāmi durdaśam || 7.33.10 ||
translation: अद्य today, एवम् thus, अमरावत्या with Amaravati, तुल्या equal, माहिष्मती Mahishmati, कृता made, अद्य today, अहम् I, तु indeed, द्विजेन्द्र O chief of brahmins, त्वाम् you, यस्मात् because, पश्यामि I see, दुर्दशम् difficult to see.
explanation: "Today, my city Mahishmati has been made equal to Amaravati, because today, O chief of brahmins, I am able to see you, who are so rarely seen."

shloka_text: अद्य मे कुशलं देव अद्य मे कुशलं व्रतम् । अद्य मे सफलं जन्म अद्य मे सफलं तपः । यस्माद्देवगणैर्वन्द्यौ वन्दे ऽहं चरणौ तव ।। 7.33.11 ।।
transliteration: adya me kuśalaṃ deva adya me kuśalaṃ vratam | adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ | yasmāddevagaṇairvandyau vande 'haṃ caraṇau tava || 7.33.11 ||
translation: अद्य today, मे my, कुशलं well-being, देव O god, अद्य today, मे my, कुशलं well-being, व्रतम् vow, अद्य today, मे my, सफलं fruitful, जन्म birth, अद्य today, मे my, सफलं fruitful, तपः penance, यस्मात् because, देवगणैः by hosts of gods, वन्द्यौ worthy of veneration, वन्दे I bow, अहं I, चरणौ feet, तव your.
explanation: O revered one, today is auspicious for me, my vow is fulfilled, my life is fruitful, and my penance is successful, because I bow to your feet, which are worshipped even by the hosts of gods.

shloka_text: इदं राज्यमिमे पुत्रा इमे दारा इमे वयम् । ब्रह्मन्किं कुर्मि किं कार्यमाज्ञापयतु नो भवान् ।। 7.33.12 ।।
transliteration: idaṃ rājyamime putrā ime dārā ime vayam | brahmankiṃ kurmi kiṃ kāryamājñāpayatu no bhavān || 7.33.12 ||
translation: इदं this, राज्यम् kingdom, इमे these, पुत्राः sons, इमे these, दाराः wives, इमे these, वयम् we, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, किं what, कुर्मि I do, किं what, कार्यम् work, आज्ञापयतु please command, नः us, भवान् your esteemed self.
explanation: O Brahmana, this kingdom, these sons, these wives, and we ourselves are at your disposal; please command us what we should do or what task is to be performed.

shloka_text: तं धर्मे ऽग्निषु पुत्रेषु शिवं पृष्ट्वा च पार्थिवम् । पुलस्त्योवाच राजानं हैहयानां तथा ऽर्जुनम् ।। 7.33.13 ।।
transliteration: taṃ dharme 'gniṣu putreṣu śivaṃ pṛṣṭvā ca pārthivam | pulastyovāca rājānaṃ haihayānāṃ tathā 'rjunam || 7.33.13 ||
translation: तं him, धर्मे regarding dharma, अग्निषु regarding sacred fires, पुत्रेषु regarding sons, शिवं welfare, पृष्ट्वा having asked, च and, पार्थिवम् the king, पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, उवाच spoke, राजानं to the king, हैहयानां of the Haihayas, तथा also, अर्जुनम् Arjuna.
explanation: Having inquired about the welfare of that king, Kartavirya Arjuna, regarding his dharma, sacred fires, and sons, sage Pulastya then spoke to him.

shloka_text: नरेन्द्राम्बुजपत्राक्ष पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानन । अतुलं ते बलं येन दशग्रीवस्त्वया जितः ।। 7.33.14 ।।
transliteration: narendrāmbujapatrākṣa pūrṇacandranibhānana | atulaṃ te balaṃ yena daśagrīvastvayā jitaḥ || 7.33.14 ||
translation: नरेन्द्र O king, अम्बुजपत्राक्ष lotus-petal-eyed, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानन one whose face resembles the full moon, अतुलं incomparable, ते your, बलं strength, येन by which, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, त्वया by you, जितः conquered.
explanation: O king, whose eyes are like lotus petals and whose face resembles the full moon, your strength is incomparable, by which Dashagriva (Ravana) was conquered by you.

shloka_text: भयाद्यस्योपतिष्ठेतां निष्पन्दौ सागरानिलौ । सो ऽयं मृधे त्वया बद्धः पौत्रो मे रणदुर्जयः ।। 7.33.15 ।।
transliteration: bhayādyasyopatiṣṭhetāṃ niṣpandau sāgarānilau | so 'yaṃ mṛdhe tvayā baddhaḥ pautro me raṇadurjayaḥ || 7.33.15 ||
translation: भयात् from fear, यस्य whose, उपतिष्ठेतां stand motionless, निष्पन्दौ motionless, सागरानिलौ the ocean and the wind, सः that, अयं this, मृधे in battle, त्वया by you, बद्धः bound, पौत्रः grandson, मे my, रणदुर्जयः unconquerable in battle.
explanation: That grandson of mine, who is unconquerable in battle and from fear of whom the ocean and the wind stand motionless, has been bound by you in combat.

shloka_text: पुत्रकस्य यशः पीतं नाम विश्रावितं त्वया । मद्वाक्याद्याच्यमानो ऽद्य मुञ्च वत्सं दशाननम् ।। 7.33.16 ।।
transliteration: putrakasya yaśaḥ pītaṃ nāma viśrāvitaṃ tvayā | madvākyādyācyamāno 'dya muñca vatsaṃ daśānanam || 7.33.16 ||
translation: पुत्रकस्य of my son, यशः fame, पीतम् consumed, नाम reputation, विश्रावितम् made known, त्वया by you, मद्वाक्यात् by my words, याच्यमानः being requested, अद्य today, मुञ्च release, वत्सम् the child, दशाननम् Dashanana.
explanation: You have diminished my son's fame and spread your own reputation, so now, at my request, release this child Dashanana.

shloka_text: पुलस्त्याज्ञां प्रगृह्योचे न किञ्चन वचो ऽर्जुनः । मुमोच वै पार्थिवेन्द्रो राक्षसेन्द्रं प्रहृष्टवत् ।। 7.33.17 ।।
transliteration: pulastyājñāṃ pragṛhyoce na kiñcana vaco 'rjunaḥ | mumoca vai pārthivendro rākṣasendraṃ prahṛṣṭavat || 7.33.17 ||
translation: पुलस्त्याज्ञाम् Pulastya's command, प्रगृह्य having accepted, ऊचे spoke, न not, किञ्चन anything, वचः word, अर्जुनः Arjuna, मुमोच released, वै indeed, पार्थिवेन्द्रः the king of kings, राक्षसेन्द्रम् the lord of Rakshasas, प्रहृष्टवत् joyfully.
explanation: Having accepted Pulastya's command, Arjuna spoke not a word, and indeed, the king of kings joyfully released the lord of Rakshasas.

shloka_text: स तं प्रमुच्य त्रिदशारिमर्जुनः प्रपूज्य दिव्याभरणस्रगम्बरैः । अहिंसकं सख्यमुपेत्य साग्निकं प्रणम्य तं ब्रह्मसुतं गृहं ययौ ।। 7.33.18 ।।
transliteration: sa taṃ pramucya tridaśārimarjunaḥ prapūjya divyābharaṇasragambaraiḥ | ahiṃsakaṃ sakhyamupetya sāgnikaṃ praṇamya taṃ brahmasutaṃ gṛhaṃ yayau || 7.33.18 ||
translation: सः he, तम् him, प्रमुच्य having released, त्रिदशारिम् the enemy of the gods, अर्जुनः Arjuna, प्रपूज्य having honored, दिव्याभरणस्रगम्बरैः with divine ornaments, garlands, and garments, अहिंसकम् non-violent, सख्यम् friendship, उपेत्य having obtained, साग्निकम् witnessed by fire, प्रणम्य having bowed down, तम् to him, ब्रह्मसुतम् the son of Brahma, गृहम् home, ययौ went.
explanation: Having released Ravana, the enemy of the gods, Arjuna honored him with divine ornaments, garlands, and garments, then, having established a non-violent friendship witnessed by fire and bowed to Pulastya, the son of Brahma, he returned home.

shloka_text: पुलस्त्येनापि सन्त्यक्तो राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् । परिष्वक्तः कृतातिथ्यो लज्जमानो विनिर्जितः ।। 7.33.19 ।।
transliteration: pulastyenāpi santyakto rākṣasendraḥ pratāpavān | pariṣvaktaḥ kṛtātithyo lajjamāno vinirjitaḥ || 7.33.19 ||
translation: पुलस्त्येनापि by Pulastya also, सन्त्यक्तः released, राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of Rakshasas, प्रतापवान् mighty, परिष्वक्तः embraced, कृतातिथ्यः having been offered hospitality, लज्जमानः feeling ashamed, विनिर्जितः defeated.
explanation: The mighty lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, though released by Pulastya, embraced, and offered hospitality, felt ashamed, having been defeated.

shloka_text: पितामहसुतश्चापि पुलस्त्यो मुनिपुङ्गवः । मोचयित्वा दशग्रीवं ब्रह्मलोकं जगाम ह ।। 7.33.20 ।।
transliteration: pitāmahasutaścāpi pulastyo munipuṅgavaḥ | mocayitvā daśagrīvaṃ brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha || 7.33.20 ||
translation: पितामहसुतः the son of the grandfather, च and, अपि also, पुलस्त्यः Pulastya, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages, मोचयित्वा having released, दशग्रीवम् Dashagriva, ब्रह्मलोकम् to the world of Brahma, जगाम went, ह indeed.
explanation: And also, Pulastya, the son of Brahma and the foremost among sages, having released Dashagriva, indeed went to the world of Brahma.

shloka_text: एवं स रावणः प्राप्तः कार्तवीर्यात्प्रधर्षणम् । पुलस्त्यवचनाच्चापि पुनर्मुक्तो महाबलः ।। 7.33.21 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ sa rāvaṇaḥ prāptaḥ kārtavīryātpradharṣaṇam | pulastyavacanāccāpi punarmukto mahābalaḥ || 7.33.21 ||
translation: एवं thus, सः he, रावणः Ravana, प्राप्तः experienced, कार्तवीर्यात् from Kartavirya, प्रधर्षणम् humiliation, पुलस्त्यवचनात् by the words of Pulastya, च and, अपि also, पुनः again, मुक्तः released, महाबलः the mighty one.
explanation: Thus, the mighty Ravana, having experienced humiliation at the hands of Kartavirya, was again released due to the intervention and words of Pulastya.

shloka_text: एवं बलिभ्यो बलिनः सन्ति राघवनन्दन । नावज्ञा हि परे कार्या य इच्छेत् प्रियमात्मनः ।। 7.33.22 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ balibhyo balinaḥ santi rāghavanandana | nāvajñā hi pare kāryā ya icchet priyamātmanaḥ || 7.33.22 ||
translation: एवं thus, बलिभ्यः than the strong, बलिनः stronger ones, सन्ति exist, राघवनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, न not, अवज्ञा disrespect, हि indeed, परे towards others, कार्या should be done, यः who, इच्छेत् desires, प्रियम् good, आत्मनः of oneself.
explanation: Thus, O delight of the Raghus, there are indeed stronger individuals than the strong, and one who desires their own welfare should never show disrespect towards others.

shloka_text: ततः स राजा पिशिताशनानां सहस्रबाहोरुपलभ्य मैत्रीम् । पुनर्नृपाणां कदनं चकार चचार सर्वां पृथिवीं च दर्पात् ।। 7.33.23 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa rājā piśitāśanānāṃ sahasrabāhorupalabhya maitrīm | punarnṛpāṇāṃ kadanaṃ cakāra cacāra sarvāṃ pṛthivīṃ ca darpāt || 7.33.23 ||
translation: ततः then, सः he, राजा king, पिशिताशनानाम् of the flesh-eaters, सहस्रबाहोः from Sahasrabahu, उपलभ्य having obtained, मैत्रीम् friendship, पुनः again, नृपाणाम् of kings, कदनम् slaughter, चकार caused, चचार roamed, सर्वाम् all, पृथिवीम् earth, च and, दर्पात् out of arrogance.
explanation: Then, that king of the flesh-eaters, having obtained a truce from Sahasrabahu, again caused the slaughter of kings and roamed all over the earth with arrogance. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रयस्त्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 33 ।। Thus ends the thirty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
